# RBI Regulatory Archive 1991-2026

Agent-first Markdown index of every Reserve Bank of India regulatory PDF, 1991-2026.
88,236 PDFs converted to GitHub-Flavored Markdown with 1:1 path parity under data/.
Source PDFs (byte-identical, upstream): https://huggingface.co/datasets/imsovikde/rbi-regulatory-archive-1991-2026

## Start here

- [Master index](INDEX.md): counts, layout, how to resolve any document
- [Progress](PROGRESS.md): live conversion percentage
- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md): pipeline design, batch protocol, failure modes
- [Manifest: 88,236-file inventory](manifest/hf_88236_inventory.jsonl)
- [Manifest: conversion ledger](manifest/sha256_conversion_ledger.csv)
- [Manifest: master catalog](manifest/master_catalog.jsonl)
- [Manifest: 81,828 direct RBI PDF URLs](manifest/pdf_final_direct_urls.txt)
- [URL to Markdown path map](index/url_to_path_map.json): O(1) lookup from any RBI or Hugging Face URL to its .md file

## Categories (0 / 88,236 converted)

- [Master-Directions](index/by_category/Master-Directions.md): 397 PDFs

## Years (1991-2026)

Per-year indexes: index/by_year/<YYYY>.md. Years with inventoried PDFs: 1992-2026 (1991 has none).

## How to find a document

1. You have an RBI URL (rbidocs.rbi.org.in or www.rbi.org.in): look it up in index/url_to_path_map.json.
2. You have a Hugging Face path: the same map covers resolve/main/<path> URLs.
3. You have a headline or document ID: search manifest/master_catalog.jsonl.
4. Converted files live at data/<Category>/<Year>/<exact PDF stem>.md, with YAML frontmatter (pdf_sha256, md_sha256, total_pages, engine).
